objective: Determine whether one fixed Qwen3.5-35B-A3B/vLLM-0.26/H20 stack executes genuine native ragged and continuous batching, with scheduler-visible ownership/lifecycle receipts and a full model-vocabulary comparison against sequential controls.

protocol_repair.predecessor_status: failed before formal result because the receipt expected tokenizer vocabulary width 248077 while vLLM returned model vocabulary width 248320
protocol_repair.preserved_gate: all model-vocabulary log probabilities at every generated step
protocol_repair.only_output_contract_change: bind dense receipt width and exact key range to the model logits vocabulary 0..248319 instead of len(tokenizer)

fixed_stack.hardware: one NVIDIA H20-3e (compute capability 9.0, at least 140 GiB GPU memory)

vocabulary_contract.dimension_authority: Qwen text_config.vocab_size and vLLM ModelConfig.get_vocab_size(), i.e. the logits output width
vocabulary_contract.sampled_token_deduplication: vLLM prepends the sampled token to all model-vocabulary IDs; the public per-step dictionary must deduplicate it to exactly 248320 keys
vocabulary_contract.dense_sidecar_indexing: column j is model token ID j for every j in 0..248319

required_pre_model_load_gates: the frozen model artifact and weight ledgers both verify
Qwen text_config.vocab_size is exactly 248320 and its config.json raw SHA matches
the eight installed vLLM source files on the active GPU runner/output path match the frozen SHA-256 map
synthetic output assembly with sampled token ID 0 deduplicates to exactly keys 0..248319
synthetic output assembly with padded model token ID 248319 deduplicates to exactly keys 0..248319
data_selection: first three distinct rows of the frozen PG19-train smoke64 JSONL; tokenize the first 50000 text characters locally; take the exact prefix lengths below

requests.lifecycle_role: waiting replacement admitted while B remains live

engine_config.engine: vLLM V1 LLM offline engine with the configured native Scheduler subclass observer

full_vocab_logprob_tolerance.comparison: all 248320 model-vocabulary entries at every generated step; identical finite/non-finite mask required

required_positive_gates: the same native SchedulerOutput admits A and B as new requests with distinct prompt lengths 1105 and 2209
at least one later native SchedulerOutput contains cached decode work for both A and B
A reaches a terminal free receipt before B
a later native SchedulerOutput admits new request C while cached request B remains scheduled
scheduler-observed simultaneously live KV block IDs are pairwise disjoint within every cache group
every block ID reported as newly allocated to a new request is present in that step's native new_block_ids_to_zero receipt
sequential A/B/C controls never contain more than one request in a SchedulerOutput
every public output-logprob mapping has exactly keys 0..248319 after sampled-token deduplication
native-batch and sequential-control generated token IDs are exactly equal for A, B, and C
native-batch and sequential-control full model-vocabulary output log-probabilities meet the preregistered tolerance for A, B, and C
a detached replay rehashes, reloads, and independently recomputes all six dense sidecars and all scheduler gates
scientific_negative_policy: If any required positive gate fails after model execution, preserve the result as a completed scientific negative; do not relabel or automatically add it to the manuscript.
infrastructure_failure_policy: Failures before any model execution are infrastructure/preflight failures, not scientific negatives.

eligible_if_all_gates_pass: native vLLM scheduler ragged admission for two different-length requests
native continuous-batching turnover from finished A to waiting C while B remains live
greedy-token and all-248320-model-vocabulary output-log-prob comparison against sequential controls on this fixed stack
